desc:
Ready to own the dance floor? Step into the spotlight in Dance Now!, the ultimate rhythm on Roblox! Inspired by legendary dance classics, it’s time to show off your moves, your style, and your rhythm! 💃✨

🎵 300+ HIT SONGS!
Dance to your favorite tracks! Groove to a massive library of 300+ hottest hits across INDO, K-POP, and J-POP genres!

🌟 3 WAYS TO PLAY
Classic Mode ⬆️: Master iconic arrow combos & hit those Perfects!
Bubble Mode 🔵: High-energy fun! Catch the rhythm across the screen.
Piano Mode 🎹 [NEW]: Become a virtuoso! Tap the falling notes to the beat.

🏆 JOIN THE PARTY
Leaderboards 👑: Compete against the best and become #1!

🎁 Join our group to claim an exclusive Title! 🎖️

✨ BETA VERSION
We are in early development! Found a bug or have suggestions? Let us know on our community server or group!
